presets.label: Gentle Drift
presets.description: Slow, soft settling with a barely-there scale change and a relaxed exit for a calm, luxurious cadence.

presets.label: Snap Cut
presets.description: Fast, punchy scene changes where items drop in nearly together and the old scene vanishes in a blink.

presets.label: Grand Drop
presets.description: Items fall from well above life size and the outgoing scene collapses deeply, for a bold theatrical landing.
askedAs: more scale on enter and exit

presets.label: Cascade
presets.description: A long, clearly sequenced stagger so each element arrives one after another like a measured reveal.
askedAs: stagger items more one by one

presets.label: Quiet Swap
presets.description: Minimal, almost static transitions with tiny scale shifts at standard pace for understated editorial pacing.
askedAs: no big zoom, just a hint
